# Kyoto Family Trip Plan: 3 Relaxed Days in April 2026

A calm, transit-only itinerary for **2 adults + 1 child** with **one temple per day**, kid-friendly meals, and indoor backups for rain. Costs below are estimated in **JPY** and stay within your **180,000 JPY** non-flight budget.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

## Day 1 — Higashiyama Arrival Day: Kiyomizu-dera and Gion
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, then take a slow walk through the Higashiyama area. Keep this light so the family can settle in.
- **Temple:** Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** in the late morning for the best balance of energy and crowd flow.
- **Afternoon:** Explore Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka, then stop for sweets or a café break.
- **Evening:** Easy dinner in Gion or near Kyoto Station, then an early night.

Estimated cost:
- Transit: **1,500**
- Temple/admissions: **1,500**
- Lunch/snacks: **5,000**
- Dinner: **9,000**
- Miscellaneous: **2,000**
- **Day total: 19,000**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/10/Kyoto_Station_November_2016_-02.jpg Alt=Day total: 19,000, Kyoto, Japan

Rain backup:
- Kyoto National Museum
- Kyoto Railway Museum
- Nishiki Market covered arcade for a shorter food-focused outing
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Nishiki Market covered arcade for a shorter food-focused outing, Kyoto, Japan

## Day 2 — Arashiyama Day: Tenryu-ji and Riverside Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Take JR or Hankyu transit to **Arashiyama** and visit **Tenryu-ji** early.
- **Temple:** Tenryu-ji is the day’s main temple stop; keep the rest of the morning relaxed.
- **Afternoon:** Walk the bamboo grove, then spend time by the river or in a park so the child has open space.
Media: Alt=Afternoon:** Walk the bamboo grove, then spend time by the river or in a park so the child has open space, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Casual dinner back in central Kyoto, then a short station-area stroll if everyone still has energy.

Estimated cost:
- Transit: **2,500**
- Temple/admissions: **1,500**
- Lunch/snacks: **5,500**
- Dinner: **9,000**
- Miscellaneous: **2,500**
- **Day total: 21,000**

Rain backup:
- Kyoto Aquarium
- Saga-Arashiyama Station area cafés
- Kyoto International Manga Museum

## Day 3 — Northern Kyoto: Kinkaku-ji and Easy Final Afternoon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Head north by bus or subway connection to **Kinkaku-ji** for the day’s temple visit.
- **Temple:** Visit Kinkaku-ji first, then keep the rest of the day low-key.
- **Afternoon:** Choose one gentle activity: a garden, shopping stop, or a longer café break near the city center.
- **Evening:** Final family dinner with an early return to the hotel and packed luggage.

Estimated cost:
- Transit: **2,000**
- Temple/admissions: **1,500**
- Lunch/snacks: **5,500**
- Dinner: **10,000**
- Miscellaneous: **2,500**
- **Day total: 21,500**
Media: Alt=Day total: 21,500, Kyoto, Japan

Rain backup:
- Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art
- Kyoto Manga Museum
- Kyoto Station building for indoor dining and shopping

## Trip Budget Outlook

| Category | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Day 1 | 19,000 |
| Day 2 | 21,000 |
| Day 3 | 21,500 |
| Hotel, 3 nights | 45,000–60,000 |
| Local transit, IC cards, small taxis avoided | 6,000–10,000 |
| Food and drinks, 3 days | 45,000–55,000 |
| Temple fees and minor admissions | 4,500–7,000 |
| Buffer for rain-day changes, snacks, extras | 10,000–15,000 |
| **Estimated trip total** | **151,500–188,500** |

Recommended budget target:
- To stay comfortably under **180,000 JPY**, aim for:
  - Hotel around **50,000–55,000**
  - Food around **45,000–50,000**
  - Keep shopping/souvenirs modest
